summary: Today presents a mixed legal and market landscape driven by key High Court rulings alongside quarterly corporate earnings in retail. Primary drivers include India's regulatory probe into Scotch imports under the India-UK trade pact and strong profit growth at Reliance Jio.

bullets.text: India launched an investigation into bulk Scotch whisky imports from Britain, sparking the first major trade dispute under the India-UK free trade agreement.
Delhi High Court ruled banks cannot unilaterally reduce interest rates on court-attached fixed deposits to 3.5% without party notice or court approval.
Reliance Jio reported a 14% increase in net profit shortly following its initial public offering.
KFC and Pizza Hut operator Devyani International reported significantly narrowed Q2 losses, driven by strong same-store sales growth across India.
Karnataka High Court ruled that under Section 16 of the Hindu Marriage Act, children born from void marriages can inherit ancestral property shares.
